SQL_DOC.V_SQL: SELECT HOUSE_CODE, COMPANY_CODE, SYS_CODE, TIMESEQ, SEQ FROM PFPODMROT_KEP WHERE LEGJOBFLAG = '100' ORDER BY HOUSE_CODE, COMPANY_CODE, SYS_CODE, TO_NUMBER(SEQ)
SQL_DOC.P_SQL:
SELECT 'STX2' AS BUYER , 'KA' AS SITE , ORGANIZATION_CODE AS PLANT , PO_NO AS LEGACY_PO_NO , PO_SEQ AS LEGACY_PO_SEQ , STATUS , ITEM_NO AS BUYER_ITEM_NO , DESCRIPTION_LOC AS DESCRIPTION , SPECIFICATION , UNIT_MEASURE , CUR AS CURRENCY_CODE , UNIT_PRICE , ITEM_QTY , ITEM_AMT , REPLACE(PO_DT,'-','') AS ADD_DATE , REPLACE(RD_DATE,'-','') AS RD_DATE , DELY_TO_LOCATION , DELY_TO_ADDRESS AS DELY_TO_LOCATION_TEXT , PURCHASER_ID AS PURCHASER_USER_ID , DIVISION_CODE AS PURCHASER_USER_DEPT , PURCHASER_NAME AS REQ_USER_INFO , REMARK1 AS REMARK , REMARK2 AS REMARK2 , ADD_FIELD1 ||'^'|| ADD_FIELD2 AS IV_COLUMN , RD_DATE_FR ||'^'|| RD_DATE_TO ||'^'|| PAY_TERMS ||'^'|| PAY_TERMS_TEXT ||'^'|| TOD1 ||'^'|| TOD1_TEXT AS HD_REMARK , TIMESEQ ||'^'|| SEQ ||'^'|| COMPANY_CODE ||'^'|| SYS_CODE AS LEGACY_PR_NO FROM PFPODMROT_KEP WHERE 1 = 1 AND HOUSE_CODE = '$G_RS.HOUSE_CODE$' AND COMPANY_CODE = '$G_RS.COMPANY_CODE$' AND SYS_CODE = '$G_RS.SYS_CODE$' AND TIMESEQ = '$G_RS.TIMESEQ$' AND SEQ = '$G_RS.SEQ$'
UPDATE PFPODMROT_KEP SET LEGJOBFLAG = '200', MROWRKDATE = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD HH24:MI:SS') WHERE 1 = 1 AND HOUSE_CODE = '$G_RS.HOUSE_CODE$' AND COMPANY_CODE = '$G_RS.COMPANY_CODE$' AND SYS_CODE = '$G_RS.SYS_CODE$' AND TIMESEQ = '$G_RS.TIMESEQ$' AND SEQ = '$G_RS.SEQ$'
